name: movineiva-global-monolith
description: Root package for MoviNeiva Global Deployment

scripts.build: npm install --prefix movineva-frontend && npm run build --prefix movineva-frontend && npm install --prefix movineva-backend && npx prisma generate --schema=movineva-backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.start: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=movineva-backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm start --prefix movineva-backend
